messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw an "arrhythmia" pattern in model-serving latency across prod-gpu-pools over the last 48h. Three short, high-amplitude spikes instead of a gradual drift. Need to decide SLO/SLA tuning + remediation owners.

maria: Quick summary: p95 latency hit ~3x baseline for ~30-90s windows at 02:10 UTC, 09:05 UTC, and 15:40 UTC. Error-budget burn ~12% over 48h on affected routes. No correlated deploys found. Suspect workload bursts + cache-warm behavior.

aj: which metric are you looking at — p95 or p99? can you paste the dashboard link?

maria: p95 is the main signal, p99 is noisy but shows the tails. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/serving/latency?panel=pgp

maria: current SLO snippet (infra config):
```
service: model-serve
slo_window: 30d
slo_targets:
  - metric: latency.p95_ms
    target: 150
    allowed_burn: 0.005
```

devon: two quick proposals: 1) add a short-window operational alert (3m p95 > 300ms) that notifies ops but doesn't immediately escalate contracts. 2) create a 24h rolling SLO for early detection separate from the 30d contractual SLO.

kevin: I can own the dashboard + alert work. Plan: add 3m and 15m p95 panels, add a PD rule for 3m breaches to the latency-oncall rotation, and a lightweight runbook stub. ETA: EOD tomorrow for dashboard + runbook stub.

aj: for 24h SLO, proposal: set 24h target at 110% of monthly target to avoid flip-flopping. e.g., monthly p95 150ms -> 24h p95 165ms. This flags regressions while keeping SLA stability.

maria: agree. also propose tightening error-budget policy automation: if burn rate > 4x over 6h, automatically pause non-critical rollouts and notify stakeholders + on-call.

devon: long-term telemetry: we should add KV cache miss rate metric and batch size distribution histograms. Spikes line up with GC-like pauses on stateful nodes + elevated KV misses in the traces i sampled. Action: instrument KV miss telemetry and per-request batch size.

kevin: creating tasks in postmortem tracker now. Short list:
- dashboard + 3m alert (owner: kevin) — due: +1d
- 24h SLO proposal + stakeholder signoff (owner: aj) — due: +4d
- error-budget policy update + rollout block automation (owner: maria) — due: +7d
- telemetry: KV misses + batching (owner: devon) — due: +14d

oncall-bot: incident 2026-04-12T15:41:07Z severity: S3 closed — tags: latency-spike, kv-cache

aj: I'll draft the 24h SLO doc and ping compliance and sales about SLA implications. if customers rely on p95=150ms we need a migration note and clear comms.

maria: can we add a "spike frequency per week" diff panel to the dashboard so we can separate trend vs noise? small UX ask but helpful.

kevin: yes — adding weekly frequency count and single-number trend rate.

devon: also add a short blameless decision checklist in the runbook: 1) check KV miss rate, 2) check node GC/CPU spikes, 3) scale pool or restart route, 4) toggle batching to conservative. keep it concise for on-call.

aj: I'll author the runbook checklist and the SLO draft.

maria: can we meet briefly tomorrow 10:30 UTC (15 min) to confirm dashboards and the 24h SLO draft?

kevin: +1 — on calendar.

devon: +1

aj: +1

maria: thanks all. Recording this thread as the action-tracker source. Will follow up with the tracker links once tasks are created. :white_check_mark:
